answer:
Here is what I'd bring up, most important first.

1. A lung nodule that has not been followed up. The CT you had in the ER on Oct 18, 2025 (for the kidney stone) found an incidental 7 mm solid nodule in the right lower lung. The radiologist recommended a chest CT in 6-12 months. That window ended about now, and I see no chest CT in your records. Your records don't show anyone telling you about it. You are a never-smoker, which is reassuring, but it still needs the follow-up scan.

2. A thyroid recheck that was never done. During your March 2026 hospital stay your TSH was mildly high (7.9) with a normal free T4. The discharge papers asked for TSH and free T4 to be repeated in 6-8 weeks. I find no later thyroid test, including in your June labs.

3. Hydrochlorothiazide may still be on your list. It was stopped in the hospital on March 5, 2026 because it caused dangerously low sodium (123). But a pharmacy record and your own May 2026 eye-clinic medication list still show it as active, and your June 15 clinic note says 'continue current medications'. Your sodium on June 15 was still slightly low (134). Please confirm with your doctor and pharmacy whether you are taking it, and whether it should be removed from every list.

4. The post-hospital follow-up. You were told to see Dr. Marsh within 1-2 weeks of March 5. The next clinic visit in your records is June 15, and the plan from that visit doesn't mention the hyponatremia or the thyroid result. Raise both.

5. Diabetes care. Your A1c is 6.9 → 6.7 → 6.6% on metformin, which is improving but still above the usual target of under 7% only slightly; ask about goals. Your eye exam in May 2026 was clear, and the next one is due around May 2027. I see no urine albumin-to-creatinine test, no foot exam, and no record of the diabetes education referral being completed. Your next A1c is due around now to December.

6. Cholesterol. In Sept 2025 your LDL was 142, HDL 48 and triglycerides 155. You have diabetes and high blood pressure, so ask whether a statin is advised, and about a repeat lipid panel, since none is recorded since.

7. Vaccines. Your flu shot is due again this season (last one Nov 8, 2025). You had the first Shingrix dose on Nov 8, 2025, but I see no second dose, which is normally 2-6 months later. No Tdap or COVID shots are recorded either, though they may simply not be in these records.

8. Cancer screening. Your colonoscopy in 2019 was normal, with a repeat in 10 years (2029), so that's fine. I find no mammogram or cervical screening in these records. They may have been done elsewhere, so ask.

9. The kidney stone. You were to see your doctor within a week and a urologist if it hadn't passed in 2 weeks. I see no record that it passed or any follow-up, yet it is still listed as active. Your urine showed blood at the ER visit.

10. Housekeeping. Your records list lisinopril as an allergy (cough), and aspirin (hives); amlodipine's start date is recorded inconsistently (April vs September 2025), and lisinopril appears active in one old export though it was stopped in Sept 2025. Worth making sure your doctor's list is clean.

The records can't tell me what happened outside these sources, so some of these gaps may just be missing paperwork.
short: Overdue or unclear: follow-up chest CT for a 7 mm lung nodule seen Oct 2025, repeat TSH/free T4 after TSH 7.9 in March 2026, whether hydrochlorothiazide (stopped for low sodium) is still being taken, second Shingrix dose, flu shot, and diabetes/lipid/screening checks.
